definitions.gloss: yakuman; limit hand; highest-scoring hand in mahjong
definitions.explanation: In Japanese mahjong, one of a small set of very rare hands that score the maximum value regardless of other factors. Used figuratively for a rare stroke of luck or a situation where everything comes together at once.

examples.japanese: {役満|やくまん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: I won with a yakuman hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{役満|やくまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{震|ふる}えた→震える：02411_furueru⟧。
examples.english: When I got a yakuman for the first time, my hands were shaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{役満|やくまん}だ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: A raise and a lottery win on top of it? That's the jackpot of your life.

notes:
Mahjong scoring has ordinary hands, then {満貫|まんがん} (mangan) and higher bands, and at the top the {役満|やくまん} hands such as ⟦{国士無双|こくしむそう}→国士無双：32717_kokushimusou⟧ (thirteen orphans) and {大三元|だいさんげん} (big three dragons). A hand worth two yakuman is ⟦ダブル→ダブル：24220_daburu⟧{役満|やくまん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {役満|やくまん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to win with a yakuman
- {役満|やくまん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to complete a yakuman
- {役満|やくまん}⟦{級|きゅう}→級：28171_kyuu⟧: of yakuman class (figurative: exceptional)

USAGE:
Outside mahjong, mostly in casual talk and online: {役満|やくまん} describes a situation where every good (or bad) condition is met at once.
